# Community Code of Conduct

We want CasHp's community to be welcoming and respectful to everyone,
regardless of background or identity. Be considerate, communicate respectfully,
accept constructive feedback, and focus criticism on ideas and behavior.

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, and publishing private
information without consent are not acceptable. Follow the project's security
reporting process for vulnerabilities; do not disclose them in public issues.

Maintainers may edit or remove harmful content and may limit participation
when needed to protect the community. Report conduct concerns privately to the
repository maintainer, [casjay](https://github.com/casjay).
